rows.Origin: Bred by Christopher H. Warner (United Kingdom, before 1986).
rows.Bloom: Orange - vermilion. Moderate, spice, opinions vary fragrance. 6 to 14 petals. Average diameter 1.5". Small, single to semi-double, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, armed with thorns / prickles, climbing, few or no prickles/thorns, upright. Small, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 6' to 7' (185 to 215cm). Width: 31" to 3' (80 to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
